title: Regularity of a free boundary determined by the value of the gradient. Part 1: Third order asymptotics
summary:
This is the first part of a project concerning the regularity of the free boundary of a function, where the free boundary depends on the gradient of the function. We study the minimizer of the expression  egin{equation*} J(u) : = \int_{B_1} F(
abla u) \ dx, \end{equation*} where $F(x)$ is a uniformly convex function whose second derivatives might jump at $|x|=1$. This results in an Euler-Lagrange equation that varies over the free boundary, which we define as $$ Γ= \partial \{x \in B_1: |
abla u| >1 \} \cap \partial \{x \in B_1: |
abla u| <1 \}. $$ We consider two-phase flat points for…
